name: Galloon
description: A broad decorative band with a rule either side of it, all three on the same ramp.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 100%; height: @calc(20 + 52 * @y / @Y)%; -webkit-transform: translateY(-50%); transform: translateY(-50%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; width: 100%; height: @calc(6 + 18 * @y / @Y)%; -webkit-transform: translateY(-50%); transform: translateY(-50%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
